name: ImagePaste
description: Composites one image onto another at specified coordinates. The second image is overlaid on top of the first image, preserving transparency and using high-quality interpolation.
syntax: ImagePaste( any image1, any image2, [number x], [number y] )

params.name: image2
params.description: The image that is pasted on top of image1.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate where the upper-left corner of image2 is pasted.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate where the upper-left corner of image2 is pasted.
